story.value: In 2004, scientists at the RIKEN Nishina Center in Wako, Japan, created the first atoms of nihonium.
The name nihonium comes from the word Nihon, meaning Japan in Japanese, and means the Land of Rising Sun.
The name nihonium was proposed by its discoverers at the RIKEN Nishina Center for Accelerator-Based Science in Japan.

uses.value: Nihonium currently has no uses outside of basic scientific research.
